hero_kpi_rationale: Brunswick generates $5.4 billion in revenue, reflecting its position as a global leader in marine leisure products and its diversification across marine engines, boats, and accessories.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from the company's product and service sales.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue shows a slight increase, reflecting a combination of volume, pricing, and acquisition factors.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth, driven by product mix and pricing.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin decreased by 100 basis points, primarily due to material inflation including tariffs, partially offset by higher sales and favorable currency translation.
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin, impacted by material inflation and tariffs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin is negative at -0.8%, primarily due to restructuring, exit, and asset impairment charges ($353.1M), including $322.5M of impairment in the Navico group.
kpis.signal: Negative operating margin in 2025, affected by significant restructuring and impairment charges.

kpis.name: R&D Expense
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred for research and development of new products and technologies.
kpis.description: R&D expenses remain stable at $168.7M, representing 3.1% of revenue, indicating continued prioritization of technological innovation and ACES applications.
kpis.signal: Stable R&D investments, underscoring commitment to technological innovation.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin excluding exceptional items and acquisition accounting amortization.
kpis.description: Excluding restructuring charges, impairments, and acquisition amortization, adjusted operating margin is 6.9%, compared to 9.5% in 2024, reflecting underlying operational pressures.
kpis.signal: Adjusted operating margin of 6.9%, excluding impairments and restructuring charges.

kpis.name: Freedom Boat Club Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Net cost of acquiring Freedom Boat Club franchises and territories in South Florida.
kpis.description: Acquisition completed on September 12, 2024, of Freedom Boat Club franchises and territories in South Florida for a net cash consideration of $31.3M, strengthening position in the boat club sector.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in the boat club model to expand participation in marine leisure.

kpis.name: Gross Margin %
kpis.explanation: Gross margin expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 24.8% in 2025 versus 25.8% in 2024, impacted by material and tariff inflation (250 bps), partially offset by sales leverage (120 bps).
kpis.signal: Tariff inflation impact partially offset by pricing gains.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €5.31B in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in net sales in the comparative year.
kpis.description: 2025 revenue increases 2.4% to $5.4 billion, driven by improved market conditions in H2 and strong performance in the engine and accessories segment.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth driven by improved market conditions in the second half and wholesale orders.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividends paid per share during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in billion USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Unfavorable Global Economic Conditions
risks.summary: Global economic slowdown may reduce consumers' discretionary income, negatively affecting the company's sales and profitability, particularly for its leisure products.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the document (Item 1A). The language used is strong ('significantly affect', 'materially impact', 'adverse effect'). It is repeated and detailed, indicating a major concern for the company, especially for its discretionary products. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Changes in Trade Policy and Customs Tariffs
risks.summary: Modifications in international trade policies, including customs tariffs, increase costs, reduce competitiveness, and may lead to lower demand for the company's products.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and mentioned as affecting 'all our businesses'. The intensity of the language ('material adverse effect', 'volatile trade policy environment') and reference to specific tariffs indicate a significant and ongoing concern. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Rising Costs of Raw Materials and Components
risks.summary: Higher costs of raw materials and components, along with supply disruptions from suppliers, increase production costs and affect the company's ability to deliver products on time.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is extensively described, highlighting dependence on third-party suppliers and volatility in raw material prices. The intensity of the language ('detrimentally affect', 'significant disruption') and mention of shortages indicate high and current severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate and Credit Condition Risks
risks.summary: Rising interest rates and deteriorating credit conditions make financing purchases more expensive for customers, potentially leading to lower sales.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified as affecting customers' ability to finance purchases, particularly boats. The impact on sales is direct and the language ('adversely affect', 'decrease in sales') is clear. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Currency Exchange Rate Volatility
risks.summary: Fluctuations in exchange rates can reduce the value of international revenues (26% of total) and affect product competitiveness against foreign competitors, particularly in EUR, CAD, and AUD.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well explained with concrete examples (sales in USD, costs in EUR/CAD/AUD/BRL). Although hedging programs exist, the language ('adversely affect', 'pricing pressures') indicates a potentially significant impact on revenues and competitiveness. Approximately 26% of annual revenue is in foreign currencies. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts. Information focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects.
